_comment: Exploratory center birth curve (SPEC_D1 §2.4, §11): the O7 W2-C audit texts (10,404) scored at all 16 stage-1 checkpoints T_0..T_15 at the 1,263 probe poles (the 640 grid poles plus shuffle partners), one 131,072-token probe step per checkpoint, each checkpoint downloaded in-run and deleted after its step. Same job module and steps as the AWS lane (infra/aws_pg/steps/neurons_x_center_probe.json) with every S3 path rewritten to results/mdl/neurons/... (the box user reads only results/mdl/*). scores.npz holds raw max_a/min_a; the curve divides by the W3 grid's per-checkpoint max_abs (results/neurons/w3/grid/{1,1b}/out/<step>/stats/), which covers every neuron of every layer. Expected about 4.9 h (W2-C O7 measured about 18 min per checkpoint on an L40S); max_billed_h 7 is 1.4x. pg_git_sha names 17057bd0, which holds the shipped code; since then only manifests, steps files and budget.json changed under infra/.
